top: In 1847, just 14 years after being forced off their land on the Trail of Tears, the Choctaw Nation sent money to strangers across the ocean.
comment: They raised $170 for Irish families starving in the Great Famine. In 2017 Ireland unveiled this sculpture, Kindred Spirits, to say thank you.
topic_it: Nel 1847 i Choctaw raccolgono 170 dollari per le vittime della carestia irlandese; nel 2017 a Midleton (Cork) la scultura 'Kindred Spirits' di Alex Pentek
photo_it: Scultura Kindred Spirits a Midleton (My Modern Met + Irish Times)

title: What the Choctaw did for Ireland 14 years after the Trail of Tears #history #facts #ireland
description:
In 1847 the Choctaw Nation raised $170 for Irish famine relief, and in 2017 Ireland thanked them with the Kindred Spirits sculpture.
